There is only silence.

No one raises their voice, and I have no words of my own to offer.

Souichirou Kuzuki is dead.

Silent to the end, a specter betraying neither hope nor regret, he gave his life to the path he had chosen.

He was silent until the very end, and he died on the path he chose without showing regret or hope.

Perhaps the worn-down Magic Circuits are pressing against my nerves.

Perhaps I cannot forgive Archer for killing Kuzuki as though it were nothing. Or perhaps I am furious at myself for having no right to object even if that is so.

Unable to tell, I feel the pain in my skull grow sharper and more intense.
